items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I said, I know Sidney Bechet.

ctx.x: It was called 'Hear that Music.' And Bobby Sherwood was the lead. Sidney was the next to the lead in the play. And I happened to be walking down 48th Street one day, and I walked by, and the guy come out and he says, hey! Can you act? And I said, well, I don't know. I think I could act. So he said, Well, step inside. He says, step inside. He says, you want to sign up for this play? We need an understudy for Sidney Bechet.
